summary: B15: the bridge loads content/factions/ and hands the registry to the simulation, so Godot and the Rust harness run the same island; S5's registry seam closes

coordination.notes: Three lanes share godot-rust/src/expedition.rs and two share strategy/tick.rs. B15 changes exactly one signature in expedition.rs (resolve_midnight_in) plus its callers, and touches only the body of run_hour in tick.rs; the ExpeditionState struct tail, strategic_tick's body and StrategicEvent's variant list are left alone for S6/S7. utility.rs is not touched (S6 owns it). Left standing and reported to the integrator: today's authored records are all placeholder-neutral (resource_priorities is one resource.open.needs_decision key at weight 0 and the validator refuses any other namespace; relationship_tendencies is empty), so every signal GoalWeights::from_definition reads is zero and nudge_weight(0) is exactly NEUTRAL_WEIGHT. The loaded registry therefore scores identically to an empty one, and the card's literal assertion -- authored-registry hash != empty-registry hash -- cannot hold without content answering an Open brief question or utility.rs widening (S6 owns it, and this lane was told not to widen from_definition). the_authored_registry_changes_the_tick pins that equality as an honest negative and proves the wiring against a probe record with one Open question answered; reverting run_hour fails it.
